blocks.note: `TAt`, the autoFocus check three leaves run: absent or exactly `true`, and anything else answers the sentence
`xAt`, the hover-scope key check: a non-empty string of at most `RAt`, without a control character, and each refusal says what happens instead — the key is dropped and names no scope
`wVe`, the press check: the leaf must be held by a plugin of this chain, which for a press means a plugin name and a whole-number handle
`PAt` (1e9), the line a Code block may start at

`Lto`, the Code leaf problem: props are `{ source }` and any of language, path, startLine, format, wrap, with no other key and no children; source by `ace`, language and path by `xye`, then startLine as a positive safe integer within `PAt`, format one of source or diff, and wrap one of wrap or truncate-end — every sentence prefixed with `Code`

`cur`, the four fields an Input admits beside `key` and `autoFocus`, and `jto`, the Input leaf problem: the props are checked by an every-key sweep rather than a picker, then the four fields in list order, then autoFocus, then the press — and children last, so `Input "<key>" takes no children` is the one sentence with no field name in it

the checks an Input and a Select share: `ZAe`, a string that is not blank once trimmed, `JPn` (4096), the pixel bound an Svg side is measured against, and `uur`, which admits an absent side and otherwise a finite positive number within `JPn`

the Select and the Svg: `mur` (64), how many options a Select may hold; `Qto`, the option check — `{ value, label? }` and nothing else, a value that is a string and unique within the Set the caller threads through, a label by `ace` — whose sentence is `option "<value>" <problem>`; `Zto`, the Select leaf problem, which checks the key list, the label, the value, then the options through `Qto`, then autoFocus, the press and finally children; `gur` (131072), how long an Svg source may be; and `eno`, the Svg leaf problem — source, alt, width and height, with the size pair checked together against `JPn` and `isInteractive` last
